name: Link16 PPLI Transaction Workflow
description: Workflow for processing Link-16 J2.2 PPLI messages with 5 standardized transactions

transactions.name: Prepare PPLI Message Send
transactions.description: Initialize, classify, encode, and validate PPLI message before transmission

transactions.name: Transmit PPLI Message
transactions.description: Check send conditions, assign NPG slot, and transmit message

transactions.name: Receive and Process PPLI Message
transactions.description: Decode, filter, correlate, and store received PPLI messages

transactions.name: Clear Expired Tracks
transactions.description: Check TTL and remove expired tracks from database

transactions.name: Handle Anomalies and Special Cases
transactions.description: Detect and resolve anomalies in PPLI processing
